companions.name: Achernar B
companions.description: An A-type star 1.7 times the Sun's width on a seven-year, eccentric orbit around Achernar.

radius.source: Kervella et al. (2022), A&A 667, A111, Table 4: radius of B 1.70 +/- 0.08 solar radii, from its angular diameter 0.370 +/- 0.014 mas and the Hipparcos parallax

mass.source: Kervella et al. (2022), A&A 667, A111, Table 4: model mass of B 2.02 +/- 0.11 solar masses, from its position on isochrones

temperature.source: Kervella et al. (2022), A&A 667, A111, Table 4: Teff of B 9064 +/- 624 K

orbit.source: Kervella et al. (2022), A&A 667, A111, Table 4: relative orbit of B, P 2570.94 d, i 30.32, e 0.7258, omega 172.05 degrees for the companion (the star's is 180 degrees on), node 310.91, T0 MJD 54743.44; a 7.35 au over A's record radius, the volume-equivalent 8.286 solar radii of its flattened figure (IAU au 149,597,870.7 km, nominal solar radius 695,700 km), is 190.74 of its radii

text.card: An A-type star 1.7 times the Sun's width on a seven-year, eccentric orbit around Achernar.
text.introduction: It comes within 2 au of Achernar at periastron; its disc spans 0.37 milliarcseconds, 1.70 solar radii, with 9,064 K at its surface.
